description.narrative:
Project goal: Contribute to democracy building and fullfilled human rights in accordance with the principles of the Eastern partnership agreements.
Project objective: Well-established and effective cooperation between Swedish and local EaP actors resulting in productive and long-term partnership and capacity building as well as the incorporation of civil society perspectives in advocacy activities, public awareness raising and democratic decision-making.

Stöd till den svenska plattformens verksamhet med länderna inom Östliga partnerskapet genom fortsatt stöd till ForumCiv (tidigare Forum Syd). Stödet täcker Armenien, Azerbajdzjan, Belarus, Georgien, Moldavien och Ukraina. Plattformen syftar till att bidra till en demokratisk utveckling inom länderna genom ökat samarbete mellan svenska CSO och genom stärkt samarbete med CSO från länderna inom Östliga partnerskapet. Projektet ska bidra till målet att främja ett starkare och mer pluralistiskt samhälle i dessa länder. Det syftar vidare till att stödja ett civilt samhälle som gör det möjligt för människor att förändra sina liv och samhällen på lokal, regional , nationell och global nivå. Slutligen ska projektet bidra till ökade kontakter och ökat samarbete mellan det civila samhället i länderna inom Östliga partnerskapet och EU:s medlemsländer.

Support for the Swedish Platform's activities with the Eastern Partnership countries through continued support to ForumCiv (formerly Forum Syd). The support covers Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. The platform aims to contribute to democratic development within the countries through increased cooperation between Swedish CSOs and through strengthened cooperation with CSOs from the Eastern Partnership countries. The project will contribute to the goal of promoting a stronger and more pluralistic society in these countries. It further aims to support a civil society that enables people to transform their lives and communities at local, regional, national and global levels. Finally, the project will contribute to increased contacts and cooperation between civil society in the Eastern Partnership countries and the EU member states.

The progress achieved, according to the final reporting towards the objectives and goals established in the project proposal for the period 2019-2023, is mainly presented at output level. Nevertheless, some unexpected outcomes and lessons learned are identified.
Some important outcomes are:
1. Strong, informed and active Swedish civil society on the development in the Eastern partnership region
- At the end of the project period, the Network's members had grown from 19 to 37 organisations. The diversity of the participants that have been engaged in discussions, meetings and capacity building activities have enhanced the strategic understanding of the regional challenges and the capacity of the member organizations to align their activities with regional priorities. It has also promoted the building of lasting professional relationships, joint initiatives and improved cooperation mechanisms.
2. Eastern Partnership Civil Society Forum (EaP CSF) works as a democratic platform, enabling dialogues between civil society actors in the EaP region and towards EU.
- At the end of the project period, the Network's promotion of Swedish Civil Society Organisations' (CSO's) understanding of the EaP CSF and it's structures and challenges had contributed to an expanded membership of the Forum, and facilitated the instrumental role of Swedish CSOs in the shaping of the Forum's policies and strategies, such as the adoption of the Gender Mainstreaming Strategy. The Network also contributed to several policy initiatives that aligned Swedish regional policies with the priorities of civil actors in the EaP region, a result from engagement with Swedish policymakers and the EaP CSF.
3. Strong and effective cooperation and partnership between Swedish civil society actors and local civil society in the EaP.
- By means of exchange visits, field trips and participation in regional forums, Swedish CSOs and local partners developed joint initiatives, opportunities for dialogue, skills development and shared strategies. This ensures that local CSO's contexts and challenges are taken into account in central policy discussions.
4. Solid representation of bottom-up perspectives of EaP-civil society in policy discussions.
- By means of different policy-related initiatives, the Network increased the visibility of EaP civil society and strengthen their relationship with Swedish policy makers. The recognition of grassroot priorities in institutional frameworks demonstrate a shift in behaviour where Swedish authorities actively engage with civil society actors to inform their strategies.
Some unexpected outcomes that stand out are:
- Increased legitimacy of the Network members thanks to the visibility and credibility that the Network has established towards key actors such as the Swedish Ministry for Foreign Affairs (MFA).
- A deeper knowledge among Swedish institutions on the EaP region, and better understanding on behalf of the Swedish MFA of the EaP CSF's structures, processes and goals. This has facilitated opportunities for policy discussions and collaborative initiatives, as well as enhanced alignment of projects with regional challenges.
- Peer-to-peer learning among Swedish CSOs and inspiration for similar forms of organisation, along with the application of the Network's methodologies for amplifying civil society voices in other regions, such as Latin America.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
